author: Fouled
body:
This sub forum is where you can create topics regarding staff complaints, questions or concerns that would normally be asked through the Avicus email. The purpose of this is for users to get faster replies regarding concerns they may have, basically a new home for support@avicus.net. If you're banned on all Avicus services, meaning that you are unable to use this sub forum, the email would be a second hand option to use. We recommend using this method as a first option though, for faster replies. It also helps us because the forums are a place where most senior staff members would be active when compared to the emails.

The difference between this and the Ask the Seniors sub forum is that, the ask the seniors is used mainly for public questions so that all community members are aware of it and avoid asking multiple questions regarding the same topic. However, this sub forum is for private complaints, questions or concerns directed towards the senior staff team.

When using this sub forum, troll questions, complaints or anything of the sort will NOT be acceptable and may result in a punishment. When posting a thread, it will only be visible to senior moderators & admins and of course, you'd be able to view your own threads. Please use the following format below if you're filing a staff complaint. If you're filing a complaint about a senior staff member, then its better to private message an admin about it.

Staff Complaint Format

Staff Members Username:

Reason of complaint:
Explanation (of what he/she is doing wrong):

Evidence:

We hope that this sub forum will be more useful towards users,
Thanks

Note: When reporting a staff member you must have sufficient evidence that clearly shows the staff member doing something they shouldn't be doing.
